decisions.reason: Prior investments and public commitment to glazed industrial sectional doors outweigh weak website visibility and possible overlap, and pandemic-related demand dips are seen as temporary.

The insulated variant represents deeper product development investment and remains aligned with the announced focus on flexible, customer-near solutions, so the firm persists despite limited archiving.
Having had its own website page signals strong public commitment and sunk costs in establishing the product, making withdrawal unlikely even if recent archival gaps suggest reduced promotion.
